senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; גדש)a heap, esp. of sheaves, shock or stack of grain; [in b. h. also mound].
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 5:7">B. Mets. V, 7</cite> <he>פוסק עמו על הג׳</he> he may conclude a bargain with him (the early harvester) for the grain in the stack (though no price has been published as yet).
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 60b:23">B. Kam. 60ᵇ</cite>. Pesik. Shubah p. 164ᵃ <he>ג׳ ג׳ של עבירות</he> heaps of sins; a. e. [V. <cite ref="C00190"><he>גָּדוּשׁ</he></cite>.]
